pricing.tier: Standard paid tier, USD per 1M tokens
pricing.note: Costs are estimates. Rates are only applied for exact model IDs listed in the script pricing table; no price is inferred for other models. Actual charges depend on account tier, discounts, cached-token billing, and pricing changes. The API catalog also returned non-Gemini generation endpoints during the initial run; their test results are excluded from this Gemini comparison. Results for Gemini models in special-purpose families (including Omni/video generation) and non-Gemini catalog entries were excluded from the comparison.

prompt.outputRequirements: Exactly 5 MCQs; exactly 4 options per question; correctIndex 0-3; non-empty explanations.

winners.bestOverallMethod: Among structurally valid quiz outputs with verified standard-tier pricing: rank-based score weighted 40% estimated cost, 35% response time, and 25% total tokens. Lower is better.
